_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::contact#8 — when a contact Newton fails, the remedy is a smaller load step, not a smaller PENALTYPARAM, and the fixture prices both. Nine runs of one self-contained two-block mortar penalty deck (two unit cubes 0.1 apart, upper one pushed down over the ramp), run 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C. Observed: at -0.9 with TIMESTEP 0.1 the run exhausts MAXITER after finalising ONE step, with 'Failed.......Number of Iterations = 50 < 50' and 'The nonlinear solver did not converge!' from solver_nonlin_nox/4C_solver_nonlin_nox_problem.cpp line 165; the identical deck at TIMESTEP 0.01 completes all 100 steps and exits 0. Raising MAXITER to 200 only changes the number in the message ('Failed.......Number of Iterations = 200 < 200'), because the failure is active-set chatter and not a stiff-system stall: over the last twenty iterations the active set alternates strictly between 4 and 0 (ACTIVE_SET_VALUES_SEEN=[0, 4], ACTIVE_SET_ALTERNATES=yes) with 52 'ACTIVE CONTACT SET HAS CHANGED' announcements, the residual alternates between exactly two values and the update norm dx is pinned at a single constant (UPDATE_NORM_IS_PINNED=yes). That also explains why it is not monotone in the load: at TIMESTEP 0.1 the sequence -0.5 / -0.7 / -0.9 / -1.1 gives no / yes / no / yes, so a LARGER prescribed displacement converges where a smaller one does not. Lowering PENALTYPARAM from 1e4 to 1e2 does make the failing deck converge, and the last two arms show what it costs: measured from 4C's own report of the two facing corner nodes, the final gap is -0.012723 for the small-step stiff-penalty run and -0.649672 for the soft-penalty one, i.e. more than fifty times the interpenetration. Convergence bought with accuracy, which is why the penalty is the second thing to reach for.
expect_in_output: The nonlinear solver did not converge!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: give the failing arm the smaller time step the entry prescribes. It then finishes all 100 steps, EXIT_FAIL_DT01 becomes 0 and the chatter markers vanish, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the raised-cap arm the same way. 'Failed.......Number of Iterations = 200 < 200' disappears and EXIT_MAXITER200 becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.

remove the penalty contrast: run the soft-penalty measurement arm with the stiff penalty and the small step, i.e. identical to its partner. The two gaps then coincide, SOFT_PENALTY_PENETRATES_FURTHER flips to no, so the fixture must go red.
